verify.errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
verify.errors.invalid_details: We could not verify those details. Please check your name and number and try again.
verify.errors.phone_format: Please enter a valid Sri Lankan telephone number.
verify.errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
verify.errors.expired: This code has expired. Please ask for a new one.
verify.errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Please try again later.
verify.errors.cooldown: Please wait {seconds} seconds before asking for a new code.
verify.errors.unavailable: Verification is not available right now. Please try again later.
verify.errors.network: Network problem. Please check your connection and try again.
verify.success.greeting: Welcome back, {name}! You are now verified, so you can ask me about your account.
access.customer_service_blocked: Help with accounts, bills, connections, faults, packages and usage is only available through SLT's dialing services. Please call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or for prepaid dial {prepaid}. You can also verify as an existing user to get full access.
llm.safety_blocked: I am sorry, I cannot help with that request. Please ask me something else about SLT-MOBITEL.
otp.sms_body: SLT-MOBITEL: Your verification code is {code}. It is valid for {minutes} minutes. Do not share it with anyone.
otp.email_body:
Hello,

Your SLT-MOBITEL verification code is {code}. It is valid for {minutes} minutes.

Do not share this code with anyone. SLT-MOBITEL will never ask you for it.

If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this email.
customer.reauth_needed: To show your account details I need you to verify again. Please verify with a one time code and then ask me again.
customer.unavailable: I cannot reach your account details right now. Please try again later, or contact SLT directly: call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or call {prepaid} for prepaid.
customer.changes_not_supported: I can only show account information here, I cannot make changes. To buy, activate, change or cancel anything, please call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or call {prepaid} for prepaid.
session.expired: Your verified session has ended, so I can no longer open your account details. Please verify again with a one time code, or contact SLT directly: call the hotline {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or call {prepaid} for CDMA prepaid.
tool_agent.not_found: I could not find that in the SLT information I have. Please call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or call {prepaid} for prepaid.
tool_agent.hub_unavailable: The SLT information service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly, or contact SLT: call {hotline} (toll free from SLT lines), send an SMS to {sms}, or call {prepaid} for prepaid.
tool_agent.session_expired: Your verified session has ended, so I can no longer open your account details. Please verify again with a one time code and then ask me again.
tool_agent.more_offer: There are {count} more. Would you like me to read them?
confirm.ask: {action}: {details}. Please say yes or tap Confirm within {seconds} seconds to go ahead, or say no to cancel.
confirm.cancelled: I cancelled that. Nothing was changed.
confirm.expired: That request timed out, so I did not do it. Nothing was changed. Ask me again if you still want it.
confirm.invalid: I could not find a request waiting for your answer. Nothing was changed.
confirm.disabled: This feature is not switched on, so nothing was changed.
confirm.off: I can't make changes through this assistant yet, so nothing was changed. Please dial the hotline {hotline} (or {prepaid} for CDMA prepaid) and they will help you.
confirm.failed_lead: The request was not completed. SLT replied:
confirm.unreachable: I could not reach SLT, so I cannot tell whether it went through. I did not try again. Please check your account or dial {hotline} before asking again.
confirm.reauth: Your sign in has ended, so nothing was changed. Please verify again.
confirm.refused: I am not allowed to do that, so nothing was changed.
confirm.pkg.unreadable: I could not read the package list right now. Nothing was changed. Please try again later.
confirm.pkg.none: I could not find a package that matches. Nothing was changed. Please tell me the package name again.
confirm.pkg.unknown_service: I cannot tell which kind of connection this is, so I cannot buy a package. Please dial {hotline}.
confirm.fault.ask_service: Which service is the fault with: broadband, voice, PEO TV or other?
confirm.fault.ask_which: Which connection is it? Reply with the number: {options}
confirm.fault.ask_contact: What contact number should SLT call you on? Say skip if you do not want to give one.
confirm.fault.ask_nature: In a few words, what is the problem? Say skip to leave it blank.
confirm.fault.none_found: I could not find a service to log a fault for. Please dial {hotline}.
confirm.fault.stopped: I stopped the fault report. Nothing was logged.
confirm.fault.bad_choice: I did not understand that. Please reply with one of the numbers.
